# Situation
Scarlet was near Blues Point Tower.
Blues was at Walsh Bay.
The ferry wharves were at Circular Quay.
The east wharf was at Circular Quay.
Wharf 3 was at Circular Quay.
Wharf 4 was at Circular Quay.
The finger wharves were at Walsh Bay.
The northwest pylon was on the north shore.
The searchlight hovered over the harbour.
# Order — Control to Bravo
Bravo, прямуйте до Blues Tower.
Search the Circular Quay wharves.
Search the finger wharves.
Search the ferry wharves.
Search Wharf 3.
Fly to the northwest pylon and hold near the base.
Conduct a search of the east wharf.
Виконайте обліт проти годинникової стрілки.
